summary:
M2 passed: the policy, trained from scratch, scores 8 goals per match against idle opponents (150M samples, about 1 hour), with 0.8 wall deaths per player.

M3 is running (run m3b, started from the M2 weights) against a mixed pool:
  • the provided bots
  • 7 new, much stronger scripted training bots (relay scores ~10.9 per match and beats baseline 32-0)
  • 10% mirror self-play
It also uses the long-horizon win objective.

Review: 3 capped rounds are complete for Phases 1-2; all critical and major findings are fixed. Your ramp fix is applied everywhere. Another session pushed old-approach work to main; I merged it rather than overwriting it (the engine is behaviour-identical, and all tests pass).

updates.text: Exact simulator (bit-identical to engine), feature encoder, PPO trainer done; M2 training started on the training machine.
Phase 1 reviewed (2 critical reward bugs fixed). Exporter (M1) done: bit-exact, ~1 ms callbacks. Evaluation harness done. League + mirror self-play added. m2b training.
M2 learning: 3.2 goals/match vs idle at 38M samples. Review round 2 fixes in. Replay viewer added. Idle-bonus shaping artifact found and fixed.
M2 gate passed (8 goals/match vs idle). 7 strong scripted training opponents added. Review round 3 done. M3 (m3b) running. Merged another session's push to main without loss.
